messages:
michelle: Quick pulse — thinking about doing a neighborhood outing next Wed evening. Two vibes: 1) tacos + trivia at La Taqueria (casual, noisy) or 2) boba + board games at The Den (cozy). Vote with :one: for tacos/trivia, :two: for boba/games. Also pick a time: `6pm` or `7:30pm`. Any dietary constraints?

aj: 1️⃣ for tacos. `6pm` works best for me. I can cover a round of tacos if we’re doing teams :taco:

samir: 2️⃣ — board games please. need a quieter spot. 7:30pm for me (day job runover)

claire: 1️⃣ but 7:30 is fine too. if trivia, do we want to reserve a table?

natalie: 2️⃣ and I’ll bring two small games (Azul, Coup). Boba spot has couches so good for hanging. Also allergic to cilantro heads-up :slightly_frowning_face:

leo: 1️⃣ but can do 2️⃣ if most prefer. can host game setup at The Den (have space)

riley: 2️⃣! prefer earlier if possible — can make 6:30 at the den?

pollbot: Poll created: 1) Tacos + Trivia — 3 votes; 2) Boba + Boardgames — 4 votes. Option times: 6pm (4 votes), 7:30pm (3 votes). Poll expires in 24h.

michelle: Awesome — looks like boba + board games is edging out. Logistics proposals: meet at 6:30 at The Den (gives folks time to finish up). Leo/natalie — can you reserve a corner couch/seat? If not, we’ll try to get there at 6:15 to snag spots.

leo: I’ll swing by earlier and put down jackets to save spots. I can DM the host for a small table — should be fine.

aj: If we’re near the taco place after, I’d still be down to grab a late snack. Bringing cash?

claire: I’ll grab a portable bluetooth speaker in case music needed. Also I’ll start a tiny rota for bringing snacks/drinks in thread replies (super low-effort).

michelle: Perfect. Final check — allergies: natalie (cilantro). Anyone else?

samir: none here.

riley: dairy-free option pls (lactose).

michelle: noted. I’ll post a final pinned message tomorrow with the meetup time and exact address. Thanks y’all :party_parrot:

leo: woohoo, board games night! :game_die::boba:

pollbot: Poll closed: Boba + Boardgames — 5 votes; Tacos + Trivia — 3 votes. Final time: 6:30pm.

michelle: Locked in — see you Wed 6:30pm at The Den. RSVP thread: michelle (yes), aj (yes, might taco after), samir (yes), claire (yes), natalie (yes), leo (yes), riley (yes).
